x-copybutton.description: The attribute value doubles as the CSS selector for what to copy — `x-copybutton="#snippet"`. Leave it empty to copy the host element's own text.

label.description: Accessible name for the button (`aria-label`/`title`). Defaults to `Copy`.

position.description: Corner the button is placed in, e.g. `top-right` (default).

copy-feedback.description: Message shown after a successful copy. Defaults to `Copied!`.

copy-duration.description: How long the feedback stays visible, in milliseconds. Defaults to `2000`.

copy-target.description: CSS selector for the element whose text is copied. Same as passing the selector to `x-copybutton` directly; `target` is read first.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
